answers.rationale: A-101 has an award amount of 50,000 (awards.csv). Recorded disbursements total 35,000 (20,000 on 2024-02-15 plus 15,000 on 2024-06-15 in disbursements.csv). program_rules.txt defines remaining obligation as award amount minus sum of disbursements: 50,000 - 35,000 = 15,000.
A-102 is a SEED-FAST award (awards.csv). program_rules.txt states that SEED-FAST awards have no cash-match requirement.
status_fragment.txt defines code A as Active. awards.csv lists status_code A for A-101 and A-102 only; A-103 is C, A-104 is S, and A-105 is H.

A-101 is a SEED-CORE award with amount 50,000 (awards.csv). program_rules.txt requires a cash match of 20% of the award amount for SEED-CORE awards: 0.20 × 50,000 = 10,000. No waiver for A-101 appears in this packet.

A-104 has status_code S (awards.csv), but status_fragment.txt only defines A (Active) and C (Closed) and states that other codes used by finance are not listed. The packet does not establish what S means.

A-105 is a SEED-CORE award subject to the 20% cash-match rule (program_rules.txt), but the packet does not include waiver letters. program_rules.txt explicitly states that absence of a waiver in this packet is not a denial that a waiver exists elsewhere, so waiver status for A-105 cannot be established.
